parameters.name: KeyId
parameters.description:
The globally unique ID of the CMK.

>  You can import key material only for CMKs whose Origin parameter is set to EXTERNAL.

parameters.name: WrappingAlgorithm
parameters.description: The algorithm that is used to encrypt key material.

parameters.name: WrappingKeySpec
parameters.description: The type of the public key that is used to encrypt key material.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms get-parameters-for-import --key-id 202b9877-5a25-46e3-a763-e20791b50000 --wrapping-algorithm RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5 --wrapping-key-spec RSA_2048 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms GetParametersForImport --region cn-hangzhou --WrappingKeySpec RSA_2048 --KeyId '202b9877-5a25-46e3-a763-e20791b50000' --WrappingAlgorithm RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5
